name: Stockholm Nordtech Group AB
summary: Stockholm Nordtech Group AB is a private equity firm specializing in small and medium-sized SaaS companies, growth, technology, B2B software companies, in the Nordics. The firm focused on acquiring and developing niche software companies and supporting their long-term growth. acquires and develops niche software companies in the Nordic region. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
